1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
